newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- President Jacques Chirac to give a television interview on Thursday, expected to address health spending, pensions, education and answer questions on his government's policy, its low rating in the polls and Europe.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe does not rule out breaking up Thomson prior to a privatisation.
-- Results of a Caisse des Depots offer on Credit Foncier de France to be made public today after bourse close.
-- Banque Lazard to pull out of Bernard Arnault group, whose prize asset is LVMH, under offer to buy out minority shareholders of Arnault holding companies Au Bon Marche and Financiere Agache.
-- Boeing expects Airbus to be its only competitor 20 years from now; is reluctant to follow Airbus in competition for giant aircrafts.
